propositions: Portable credential-free end-to-end Cloud/DC test suites must cover mixed success, transient recovery, long-delay deferral, permanent failure, auth/provider stop, fuse open/reset, label-first create, restart, partial outcome, and delivery failure scenarios.
Route census and poison checks must verify no removed production fallback paths are reachable and that the legacy coordinator route is poisoned.

ADR 0103 must be finalized to document retry ownership, failure taxonomy, fuse/containment logic, intentional deltas, expand/contract cutover, and rollback that re-observes remote state without deleting successful Jira work.
All portable test suites must run without external credentials in every supported local and CI environment and pass ADR/doc index and route-census mandatory gates.
Architecture and operator documentation must define versioned outcome contracts and future adapter atomic-operation and retry obligations.
Rollback behavior must guarantee that remote state is re-observed and successful Jira work is never deleted.
